name: Double Exposure
source:
Erin Darabondi's surreal photography served as an inspiration for your artistic career. You were thrilled, then, when you were selected to be one of two artists permitted to work in her old studio, and to produce new works inspired by her.

Your fellow grant winner seems a bit more interested in digging up the truth about Erin's mysterious disappearance. You'd rather focus on your art.

Until that quickly becomes impossible...

[From [url=https://subtleart.itch.io/double-exposure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾琳·达拉邦迪 (Erin Darabondi) 的超现实摄影为你的艺术生涯提供了灵感。然后，当你被选为两名获准在她的旧工作室工作并受她启发创作新作品的艺术家之一时，你感到非常兴奋。

你的同伴资助者似乎对挖掘艾琳神秘失踪的真相更感兴趣。你宁愿专注于你的艺术。

直到这很快变得不可能……

[来自[url=https://subtleart.itch.io/double-exposure]itch.io[/url]]
